functions.tag: {title:"Notes on the Machine",author:"someone who owned one",generation:1,pages:["{\"text\": \"I have written this out because I am tired of explaining it.\\n\\nThe grey box is a computer. It is not a picture of one. It has memory and a processor in it, and if you take those out it stops being anything at all.\"}","{\"text\": \"An empty box does nothing and says so. Put memory and a processor in it and it wakes up. A graphics card is what gives it a picture; a hard drive is what gives it somewhere to keep things.\\n\\nA screen goes above it. It will find it by itself.\"}","{\"text\": \"Everything else it knows how to explain on its own.\\n\\nThere is a Manual on the desktop. Ten pages. It is better written than this book and it is already on the machine, which is the point of it.\"}","{\"text\": \"If you would rather type, open the Terminal and write:\\n\\n  man\\n\\nand it will list the pages.\\n\\nThat is all I meant to say. Go and put something in the box.\"}"]}
